title: 5 new ways to level up your learning with Search
gist: Google is pushing AI-native education features directly into Search and AI Mode — generative interactive visuals, free practice quizzes for major standardized tests via test-prep partners, Lens-based step-by-step problem coaching, Gemini Notebook integration inside Search, and AI-generated study documents — extending Google's AI monetization and engagement surface beyond the Gemini app into core Search.

insights.claim: Google has launched Generative UI capabilities globally in English in AI Mode, letting Search produce custom interactive visuals and simulations (e.g., a pH scale tool that can be customized to plot specific items) directly in response to open-ended queries, with the capability starting to roll out in AI Overviews as well.
insights.speaker: Awaneesh Verma
insights.so_what: Generative UI turns Search from a link-retrieval product into a dynamic content-generation engine, which could reduce click-through to third-party educational/reference sites and further concentrate attention within Google's own AI surfaces.
insights.quote: Generative UI capabilities have launched globally in English in AI Mode and have started rolling out as well in AI Overviews.

insights.claim: Search now offers free customized practice quizzes for major standardized tests (ACT, AP, ENEM, GRE, JEE, LSAT, MCAT, NEET, SAT) by partnering with test-prep companies The Princeton Review, Careers360, PhysicsWallah, and Akira Enem to source authoritative content, available globally in English in both AI Overviews and AI Mode at no charge.
insights.speaker: Awaneesh Verma
insights.so_what: By licensing content from incumbent test-prep firms rather than building it independently, Google is embedding itself as the distribution layer for exam prep, which could commoditize standalone test-prep apps while making those data/content partners dependent on Google's traffic and terms.
insights.quote: Thanks to our partnership with leading education companies The Princeton Review, Careers360, PhysicsWallah, and Akira Enem, these quizzes tap into trusted, authoritative content from test-prep experts
insights.locator: 2. Test your knowledge with practice quizzes.

insights.claim: In the coming weeks, Google Lens will roll out globally in English a new step-by-step tutoring experience: users photograph their work and get an AI Overview that explains steps, pinpoints specific mistakes, and coaches them through the problem, with follow-up continuing in AI Mode.
insights.speaker: Awaneesh Verma
insights.so_what: Turning a camera-based visual search tool into an error-diagnosing tutor extends Google's AI reach into homework-help use cases currently served by apps like Photomath and Chegg, pressuring their competitive position.
insights.quote: You'll get an AI Overview that provides helpful explanations, pinpoints where you may have made mistakes, and coaches you when you’re stumped on a problem.

insights.claim: Google is bringing Gemini Notebook (the renamed NotebookLM) directly into AI Mode within Search, rolling out over the coming days across more than 180 countries in English, with existing notebooks from the Gemini app automatically syncing sources and instructions into Search.
insights.speaker: Awaneesh Verma
insights.so_what: Cross-product syncing of notebooks signals Google is consolidating its AI product surfaces (Search, Gemini app, NotebookLM) into a single unified user context/memory layer, increasing switching costs and creating a moat via accumulated personal data.
insights.quote: Your existing notebooks from Gemini Notebook or the Gemini app will appear automatically in Search, syncing the sources and instructions for each notebook across Google products.

insights.claim: AI Mode can now generate ready-to-use study documents (one-pagers, slide presentations, spreadsheets, text files) directly from a user's uploaded files or prior AI Mode threads, having rolled out globally in English with AI Overviews support coming soon.
insights.speaker: Awaneesh Verma
insights.so_what: Native document generation inside Search competes directly with productivity/office suites for a specific workflow (turning scattered source material into a finished document), a use case investors should watch for encroachment on Microsoft Office and Google Workspace's own paid tiers.
insights.locator: 5. Create custom files to streamline your studies.
